unblockPath.label: UNBLOCK_PHASE_9B_10B
unblockPath.authArtefact: external owner-only DEV storage state captured by `npm run auth:capture -- --env=dev --output=$HOME/.nightwatch/auth/ripple-dev-state.json`; never committed, never copied into the repository
unblockPath.containmentEnvelope: L6 nightwatch.process-network-containment.v1 for authenticated subprocesses, or the browser harness with its outer loopback proxy; the pre-browser auth gate always runs first
unblockPath.targetSet: the bounded approved read-only canary set (currently ripple.common-exchange.read; Phase 10B adds the deep item-level type contract); no selector, no fallback, no third attempt
unblockPath.acceptanceCriteria: evaluatePhase9bAcceptance (Phase 9B) or evaluatePhase10bDeepAcceptance (Phase 10B) passes on FIRST and REPLAY with CONTAINED_DEV evidence, deterministic replay, and zero safety/privacy violations
unblockPath.expectedEvidence: safe semantic evaluation receipts (nightwatch.semantic-evaluation-receipt.v2), the pass summaries, the replay comparison, and the acceptance summary bound to the approved read-only source SHA; raw values are never persisted

permanentClosurePath.label: CLOSE_PHASE_9B_10B_PERMANENTLY
permanentClosurePath.reason: the owner records the reason DEV acceptance will not be pursued
permanentClosurePath.consequence: the blocker is retired with a recorded reason, the semantic layer's self-description becomes permanently synthetic-only, and no future status may claim DEV acceptance

consequences: UNBLOCK_PHASE_9B_10B: one bounded, owner-authorized, post-auth-gate acceptance execution against the approved DEV target; a pass may then move acceptanceClass to DEV_ACCEPTED with CONTAINED_DEV evidence bound to the approved source SHA.
CLOSE_PHASE_9B_10B_PERMANENTLY: the phase is recorded terminal with a reason; the capability stays synthetic-only permanently and the indefinite BLOCKED state ends.
